name: team_planning_set_unit
description: Create, rename or move a unit in a scenario of a Team Planning plan. Without unit_id it creates a unit, which needs a name and a level_id from the Org Graph taxonomy. With unit_id (an Org Graph unit, or one the plan created) it changes that unit: whatever you leave out stays as the scenario has it, and a retired unit comes back. parent_id places it beneath a live unit of a kind its own kind can sit under; top_level true puts it at the top, if its kind can sit there. A unit's level can't change. scenario_id defaults to the baseline, whose id is the plan's. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. A note on a change to a person goes when they are forgotten. Any other note, such as one on a unit, a position or a rule, stays until the plan is deleted, so keep personal details out of it.

name.description: What the unit is, such as 'Payments'. Don't put a person's name in it.
